description_en: Transfers resource instances from the source cost center to the destination cost center
description_zh: 资源实例（实例型和分拆型）从源财务单元分配到目标财务单元
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi allocate-cost-unit-resource --from-unit-user-id 273394581313325532 --from-unit-id 0 --to-unit-user-id 241021678450941490 --to-unit-id 186419 --resource-instance-list ResourceUserId=273394581313325532 ResourceId=cn-hangzhou_standard CommodityCode=oss ApportionCode=qwer1-cn-beijing --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AllocateCostUnitResource

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the owner of the source cost center
parameters.help_zh: 源财务单元的属主用户ID（必传）
parameters.name: from_unit_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source cost center.

A value of 0 indicates that the resources to be transferred have not been allocated to a cost center.
A value greater than 0 indicates the ID of an existing cost center
parameters.help_zh:
源财务单元ID（必传）。
0表示未分配财务单元ID
大于0表示已分配的财务单元ID
parameters.name: from_unit_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the owner of the destination cost center
parameters.help_zh: 目标财务单元属主用户ID
parameters.name: to_unit_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination cost center.

A value of -1 indicates that the allocated resources are changed to unallocated.
A value greater than 0 indicates the ID of an existing cost center
parameters.help_zh:
目标财务单元ID，取值：
-1表示已分配资源移除到未分配。
大于0表示分配到指定财务单元
parameters.name: to_unit_id

fields.help_en:
The split item of the shared instance. This parameter is required only for shared instances.

Eight cloud services support bill splitting. The commodity codes of the eight services are oss, dcdn, snapshot, vod, cdn, live, and cbwp.
You can obtain the split item of a shared instance by calling QueryCostUnitResource operation to obtain all resource instances within a cost center
fields.help_zh:
分拆型实例的分拆型，只有分拆型产品实例才需要传这个参数。
目前分拆项产品有八种商品，其商品code分别是oss、dcdn、snapshot、vod、cdn、live、cbwp。
这个分拆项字段一般是通过QueryCostUnitResource获取用户的某一个财务单元（包含未分配）下的所有账单实例（包括分拆型实例会带分拆项）
fields.name: apportion_code

fields.help_en: The commodity code of the resource instance
fields.name: commodity_code

fields.help_en: The ID of the resource instance
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The user ID of the resource instance owner
fields.help_zh: 账单实例的属主用户ID（必传）
fields.name: resource_user_id

parameters.help_en: The resource instances to be transferred
parameters.name: resource_instance_list

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether resources are allocated to the specified cost center. Valid values:

true: The resources are allocated to the specified cost center.
false: The resources fail to be allocated to the specified cost center
IsSuccess.description_zh:
财务单元资源分配是否分配成功
true表示分配成功
false表示分配失败

ToUnitId.description_en: The ID of the destination cost center

ToUnitUserId.description_en: The user ID of the owner of the destination cost center
ToUnitUserId.description_zh: 目标财务单元属主用户ID

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
